the order below and stories in their file order. Later stories can rely on the
context established earlier.

The goal is evidence that the changed behavior works, including affected shared
behavior and real integration boundaries. Choose checks by that risk, not by a
fixed number of scenarios. Use [delivery](delivery.md) to distinguish a quick
feedback build from finalization.

## Environment and entry points

Use Windows, PowerShell 7, Python 3.11 or later and the SDK pinned in
[global.json](../../global.json). The NativeAOT launcher also needs Visual Studio

# Implement workflows over reusable boundaries

As a developer, I want to implement workflows over explicit domain and platform
boundaries so that new stories can reuse file, search, repository, and presentation
services.

[All epics](README.md)

## DomainBoundaries

As a developer, I want to implement domain behavior independently of the UI and
operating system so that I can reason about rules apart from external operations.

### Implementation decisions

- Keep Core, Infrastructure and Desktop as the three production projects. Clarify their
  responsibilities and simplify complex areas within those boundaries instead of
  migrating to a fourth Application project.
  Sources: [2026-11-10T09-47-42-01a1c4a4-4449-7cf1-bd8e-99768dcc55f0.md → Turn 2](../codex-sessions/2026-11-10T09-47-42-01a1c4a4-4449-7cf1-bd8e-99768dcc55f0.md#turn-2); [2026-11-10T09-47-4
[...]
nvironment-refresh mechanism was delegated.
  Source: [2026-11-10T10-33-24-01a1c4ce-1b81-7100-ac29-1fb6be310a0c.md → Turn 3](../codex-sessions/2026-11-10T10-33-24-01a1c4ce-1b81-7100-ac29-1fb6be310a0c.md#turn-3).

## ArchiveAccess

As a developer, I want to read and create archive content through common interfaces so
that I can reuse file workflows for packaged content.

## SearchSources

As a developer, I want to search physical/archive text and explain Git ignore decisions
through one source so that I can evolve search scheduling without embedding storage or
Git parsing in Core.
